scenes: Where does well water come from?
From an aquifer: | layers of rock and sand that hold water underground. | When pumps take more than rain puts back, the water table falls.
In north-west India, about a hundred and nine cubic kilometres of groundwater were lost in six years, | mainly to irrigation. Heat makes crops thirstier, and pumps run harder.
Put water back in the ground, and wells keep flowing.
